question: What is the name of the proposed largest sports enclave in the country, the ground breaking ceremony of which was performed by the President of India in February 2021?

options.text: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Sports Enclave

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Sports Enclave.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In **Ahmedabad**, **Gujarat**, India, a sports complex called **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Sports Enclave **has been constructed.
 
• The **sports enclave **is one of the **biggest **of its kind in India.
 
• The **Ahmedabad Urban Development Authority **and the **Gujarati government **worked together to complete the project.
 
• The construction of the sports complex was essential to **India's future hosting **of the **Summer Olympic Games **and other **important sporting events. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Sports Enclave:**

 
 
• **​**The **Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Indoor Stadium **can be found in **Surat**, Gujarat, India, on Ghod Dod Road.
 
• It was constructed in **1998 **for a price of **21 crores **by the **Surat Municipal Corporation.**
 
• **Deendayal Upadhyaya**, a seasoned **Jana Sangh leader,** was honoured with the honour of having his indoor sports complex named after him when Western India first developed.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi Sports Enclave:**
 
 
• **​**The world's largest cricket stadium, formerly known as **Sardar Patel Stadium **but now known as **Narendra Modi Stadium** in honour of the **prime leader** who is credited with conceptualising the venue in its current breathtaking shape, was opened by India's **President Ram Nath Kovind **in Ahmedabad.
 
 
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee Sports Enclave:**
 
 
• Established in **1961**, the **Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Climbing and Allied Sports** (abbreviated to ABVIMAS) is an Indian institution that offers specialised instruction in **mountaineering, skiing, **and **mountain rescue.**
 
• The institute is in the Himachal Pradesh town of **Manali**.
